about.title: About this project
about.paragraph.1: L.Orkut is a nostalgic project inspired by the early days of the internet — a time when profiles were colorful, sincere, and full of personality.
about.paragraph.2: I built this project to explore full-stack development while combining creativity, storytelling, and clean architecture.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.paragraph.1: L.Orkut is a personal portfolio project created for educational and creative purposes.
privacy.paragraph.2: This website does not collect sensitive personal data, use tracking cookies, or share information with third parties.
privacy.paragraph.3: Any testimonials or interactions displayed are part of the project experience and are not used for commercial data processing.
